description: A single line with a dot and a printed value at every point, and no grid.
overview: Uses `LineChart` with one `Line` (`type="natural"`, `strokeWidth={2.5}`) whose `dot` draws a 4-pixel filled marker, and a nested `LabelList` with `position="top"`, `offset={10}` and `fontSize={12}`. There is no `CartesianGrid`, and the top margin is 24 to leave room for labels. `chartData` holds six months of `{ month, desktop, mobile }` records; only `desktop` is plotted with `chartConfig.desktop` (`var(--blue)`). The tooltip uses `hideLabel`.
usage: Replace `chartData` and rename the `chartConfig` entry to match your series. Pass a `formatter` to `LabelList` to add units, or change `position` to place labels below points. Increase the `margin` if labels are clipped at the edges.
notes: Labels use the `fill-label` class so they follow the label color in light and dark appearance. `accessibilityLayer` is set on `LineChart`, so the plot is focusable and arrow keys move the tooltip between points.
